newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly down on high volume.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly down on high volume.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mostly lower on Tuesday on a exceptionally high volume.
* Seven of ten traded issues were down, one was flat and one up.
* Volume higher at 48,402 units, turnover 48.6 million kuna.
* Biggest decliner, hotelier Laguna, fell 170 kuna to 1,050 on volume of 80 shares.
* The only gainer, drug firm Pliva, up 800 kuna to 13,500 on volume of 951 shares.
* For third day running most active issue was Zagrebacka Banka with 33,799 units down at 980 kuna.
